height_center_rule: mean across unique players in primary accounting panel
coding: reference indicators; full panel adds 2013-14 indicator, same primary height center and priors
random_effect: z_player ~ Normal(0,1); u_player=sigma_player*z_player; deterministic numeric-ID indexing includes zero-attempt-only players

recovery.trigger: generic diagnostics only; no scientific posterior inspection before pass

diagnostics.key_parameters: all fixed coefficients including every position/season; sigma_player, log_kappa, kappa, rho

prior_predictive.stop_if: nonfinite mu, or more than 25% mu below .01, or more than 25% mu above .99; broad remaining support documented

contrast.quantiles: Q25/Q75 across all primary accounting player-seasons, unweighted, linear interpolation
contrast.primary: retain fitted player random intercept per posterior draw
contrast.secondary: set u=0; reference-player contrast, NOT marginalized over random-effect distribution

PPC.method: Beta draw then Binomial for each observed positive-FTA row, retaining fitted player effects
metrics: FT-rate SD, q05, q50, q95, zero/one fraction
PPC.serious_failure_rule: pooled rate outside 99% predictive interval OR at least 3 of global rate SD/q05/q50/q95/zero fraction/one fraction outside 99% intervals OR at least one-third of season pooled rates outside 99%; additional visual review before release

interpretation: This analysis estimates associations within NBA players with available combine measurements. It does not identify a causal effect of arm length on shooting, because combine participation, NBA selection, role assignment, persistent player differences, shooting opportunity and other factors may jointly affect the observed sample.
minute_limitation: Public NBA game-level minute displays and the archived game records agreed at the available whole-second resolution in the audited sample, while small discrepancies remained between summed game displays and NBA season-level decimal minute displays. Because season-level MIN was not the scientific outcome, exposure, or primary model predictor, and because shooting counts and analytical eligibility reconciled, the amended prospective validation protocol treated season-total MIN as an ancillary representation field rather than an exact numerical release gate. The internal NBA aggregation mechanism remains unknown.
reproduction: exact numerical summaries from saved trace; seeded refits compared within Monte Carlo uncertainty, not byte-identical traces
